reviews.text: One of my favourite serums. My skin generally loves anything derived from rice so this serum is perfect. It makes my skin feel so hydrated and doesnt irritate it at all. I use this with retinal and exfoliants with no issues.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅精華之一。我嘅皮膚一般都好啱用任何由米提取嘅嘢，所以呢款精華好啱我。用落好水潤，完全唔會刺激皮膚。我配合 retinal 同去角質產品一齊用，冇咩問題。

reviews.text: I didn't see anything special after using this. I'd also prefer a serum in a bottle as the tub is not hygienic. I may end up using it on my body so as not to waste it.
reviews.zh: 用咗之後冇見到乜特別效果。我亦都更想要瓶裝嘅精華，因為罐裝唔夠衛生。我可能最後會落喺身體度用，免得浪費。

reviews.text: Bought all the serums to try and I love the texture and how moisturising it is. Because it's on the thicker side, I use it in my night routine. Haven't seen any visible brightening effects for this Rice one yet though.
reviews.zh: 我買咗所有精華嚟試，好鍾意佢嘅質地同保濕效果。因為質地比較稠，所以我會放喺晚間護膚程序入面用。不過呢款 Rice 版暫時未見到明顯嘅亮白效果。

reviews.text: I regret only getting one of this. I’m 35 so my skin is aging and I’m starting to be able to feel I don’t have collagen as I used to. However, when I use this serum, I wake up and my skin is plump and very smooth. My mom also tried it and loved it. And she has mature dry skin. I loved everything about it! And it’s become one of the things in my routine that I don’t want to run out of.
reviews.zh: 我好後悔只買咗一支。我35歲，皮膚開始老化，開始感覺到冇以前咁多膠原蛋白。不過，當我用呢款精華，第朝醒嚟皮膚會好飽滿、好滑。我媽媽都試過，好鍾意，而且佢係成熟乾性皮膚。我對佢各方面都好滿意！呢款已經成為我護膚步驟之中一樣唔想斷貨嘅產品。

reviews.text: Love Arencia products, I have the dropper serum and thought I would try this as a thicker night time treatment but it turned out to be pretty matte after drying and it dried quick so I didn't get the slick feel I was hoping for but it did make my skin feel and look good.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意 Arencia 嘅產品，我有滴管裝嘅精華，本來想試吓呢款作為質地較稠嘅晚間護理，但係乾咗之後幾啞光，乾得好快，所以冇我期望中嗰種滑溜感，不過都令皮膚感覺同睇落都好好。

reviews.text: Although I prefer the bottle serum, this Arencia rice glow serum is great! It has a slightly thicker texture than most serums, but it has really improved the tone of my skin and has helped make my skin look more glowy since I started using
reviews.zh: 雖然我比較鍾意瓶裝嘅精華，但係呢款 Arencia rice glow 精華都好好！質地比大部分精華稍為稠身啲，但係用咗之後，膚色真係改善咗，令皮膚睇落更加有光澤感。

reviews.text: This serum texture is so cool! I really liked that it’s a gel, works well on the skin, and you can feel its effect. Just keep in mind that the product contains retinol in a low dose, so it’s better not to mix it with other active ingredients
reviews.zh: 呢款精華嘅質地好特別！我好鍾意佢係啫喱狀，塗喺皮膚好好用，而且睇到效果。不過要留意產品含有低劑量嘅 retinol，所以最好唔好同其他活性成分混合使用。

reviews.text: I purchased all the different Arencia serums, and this one is my least favorite. The main reason is that I have a very sensitive nose and don’t like its scent—it smells more like snail mucus than rice. However, the serum itself works well, leaving my skin feeling hydrated.
reviews.zh: 我買咗所有唔同嘅 Arencia 精華，呢款係我最唔鍾意嘅。主要原因係我嗅覺好敏感，唔鍾意佢嘅味道——佢個味道更似蝸牛黏液，而唔似米。不過，精華本身效果都好好，用完皮膚感覺水潤。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
